ready2_open_rewrite.final_cot: Image description: In the figure, the four points A, B, C, and D are all on the same circle. Chords AC, AD, BC, and BD are drawn inside the circle. The angle at point A formed by AC and AD is labeled 5x; the angle at point B formed by BC and BD is labeled (7x−8)°. Reasoning: ∠CAD and ∠CBD are both inscribed angles, and their endpoints are both C and D, so they intercept the same arc CD. According to inscribed angles subtending the same arc being equal, 5x = 7x − 8. Solving gives 2x = 8, so x = 4. The required m∠A = 5x = 5 × 4 = 20.

method.method_draft: From the diagram, identify that A, B, C, and D lie on the same circle. Read the marked angle at A as ∠CAD = 5x and the marked angle at B as ∠CBD = (7x−8)°. Both inscribed angles have endpoints C and D, so both intercept the same arc CD. Use the inscribed-angle theorem: inscribed angles intercepting the same arc are congruent. Set 5x = 7x − 8, solve x = 4, and compute m∠A = 5x = 20.
